attempts.why: Change dialog article to dialog > article so modal sizing/centering/margins apply only to the top-level modal container, preventing nested articles from inheriting modal width/margin/max-height and overflowing the content padding box.

selfVerify.reason: inner article now correctly inset to outer's content box (x118 = outer x100 + 18px padding, right edge 782 = 800-18) with width 664 matching outer content width, instead of prior overflow (x136, 136+664=800 flushing to outer border box). Nested card retains its own padding (inner p at x136 = 118+18).

pick.suspected: Nested <article id=inner> inside modal <article id=outer> is mis-aligned/overflows: outer has ~18px content padding (p at x118 vs outer x100) but inner is shifted to x136 and flush to outer right edge (136+664=800 vs outer 100+700=800), overflowing content box by 18px. Indicates overly-broad selector in modal/card (e.g. `dialog article` / `article` instead of `dialog > article` / `:where(article):not(article article)`) applying modal centering/negative header margins/padding to all descendant articles, not just the top-level modal container.
